index idx_dot_delegation_edges_receiver: CREATE INDEX idx_dot_delegation_edges_receiver ON dot_delegation_edges (receiver_dot_id)
table dot_delegation_edges: CREATE TABLE dot_delegation_edges ( caller_dot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dots(principal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, receiver_dot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dots(principal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, outbound_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (outbound_enabled IN (0, 1)), inbound_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (inbound_enabled IN (0, 1)), generation TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (caller_dot_id, receiver_dot_id), CHECK (caller_dot_id <> receiver_dot_id) ) STRICT
